name: issue-groom
description: A maintainer opens an issue; om-auto-manage-issues adds SDLC labels, a Definition of Ready check and implementation notes (ADR 0017). `authors` is the gate: the run holds Bash with no allowlist, so an issue from anyone else is groomed only when a maintainer adds `groom`. Issues a run holds or a human put on hold never match.

name: issue-regroom
description: A label only a collaborator can set: `groom` re-runs om-auto-manage-issues on one issue (an external report a maintainer vouches for, an edit, a reply). The override removes the label first.

name: issue-autofix
description: A human adds `autofix`; om-auto-fix-issue drives the issue to a reviewed PR on develop (ADR 0017). Held, blocked, do-not-merge or spec-pending issues never match.

name: issue-spec
description: A human adds `spec` to a `feature` issue; om-auto-write-spec lands .ai/specs/<date>-<slug>.md on a design-only PR (ADR 0017).

name: pr-autopilot
description: A human maintainer opens a PR; om-pr-autopilot diagnoses and runs the right chain, never merges (ADR 0017). Agent PRs (authored by design4pro-agent, the cockpit's gh identity) and dependabot are excluded by author; pipeline labels exclude the race with om-open-pr.

name: pr-review-threads
description: The `claude-review` job left unresolved review threads on a PR and applied `review-threads`; om-auto-fix-pr drives the PR to merge-ready and resolves them (ADR 0017). Without this the PR waits for a human to run the same skill by hand. `includePullRequests` is read by the host patch in .ai/scripts/cezar-host-patch.sh - stock cezar 0.10.1 drops every label event on a PR, so this automation does not fire without it. The gate is the label: only a collaborator or the Actions bot can set one, and the review job applies it once per head SHA. The run removes it as its first mutation, so a label still present is a run nobody took.
